results.content:
Same here. I’ve been building for 4 months and once I got to the production readiness stage, the pages that were working fine are suddenly broken, all of them. I then asked it to repair the files and they broke the app even more. I took 2 days off the platform because it was just too much to handle. all the work is basically lost. I tried to upload a version of the app I saved but that is not working either. This is the most frustrating thing. All that work lost. Not to mention the constant repeating prompts and sending images as examples to show what I mean but yet it doesn’t comprehend, “repair the messaging system and restore the elements lost in the previous prompts that had nothing to do with messaging” [...] # AI Studio is dead: The platform is broken and unusable

It’s time to face the truth: AI Studio is effectively dead. What used to be a powerful, streamlined tool for developers has been turned into a broken platform that simply doesn’t work.

The recent changes have completely ruined the user experience. Constant bugs, failed indexing, and a UI that feels increasingly disconnected from a professional workflow have made it impossible to rely on. It’s no longer a productive environment; it’s a site that fails at its most basic functions.

They ruined a great platform. It’s time to stop making excuses—it just doesn’t work anymore.

Great job, Trying to chase the market, you rolled out a raw, non-functional update, completely ignoring the people who actually use it. [...] Imagine all the pages and the modal boxes broken and no way for ai agent to understand what you mean? This is a disgrace and very troubling. Wasted 4 months of work. I am upset.

Years of work that i was making patient is suddenly unusable.. Why make a platform that you will destroy later.. could have just not made it in the first place.. ruined everything

100%. It is the worst Ai platform I have used so far. And I’ve used most of them.

100% Agreed. Google made a harakiri, Live… BUT we are the ones that it hurts. Not only AI, but just everything Google. No more Chrome, no more Google search engine, no more gmail, nothing.

I think i’m going to do the same. I am going to just be rid of any google service at this point.

results.title: Augie Launches First-of-its-Kind Credit Card Designed to Help Consumers Build Credit and Dramatically Expand Access to the Financial System
results.content: NEW YORK, March 4, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- For the more than 50 million Americans seeking to establish credit, there's a frustrating paradox: without established credit, it is almost impossible to get access to credit products; and without access to credit products, one cannot establish a credit track record. Alternatively, those without credit history must set aside hundreds of dollars in security deposits to get a credit card – money that could be used for other essential needs. Today, Augie is introducing a fundamentally different approach, enabling consumers to build credit on their own terms without setting aside large security deposits for extended periods, paying card fees, or incurring interest charges.
